story.title: The Bat That Hunts the Dark Streets of Capiz

sentences.text: If a silent shadow follows you at night in Capiz... don't look back.
The old tales say a trusted neighbor can shed their human skin by midnight.
They fly through the sleeping village on leathery wings, searching for open roofs.
You might hear a strange clicking sound tapping softly against your wooden window.
Wise elders warn families to hide beneath woven mats and pray until dawn.
Those who foolishly step outside find themselves hunted down a lonely dirt path.
A sudden shriek cuts through the thick mist as sharp claws strike from above.
Only a dropped lantern and a dark smear remain where someone once stood.
